results.text: Comparison of Cardiovascular Outcomes Between Chlorthalidone and Hydrochlorothiazide in Hypertensive Patients. Chlorthalidone (CLTD) and hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) are widely used thiazide diuretics for hypertension management. This study aimed to evaluate and compare the cardiovascular outcomes of patients treated with CLTD versus HCTZ. Heart Rate Control with Landiolol Hydrochloride in Infants and Neonates During Cardiac Surgery. Perioperative tachyarrhythmias are common in children undergoing cardiac surgery, contributing to significant mortality and morbidity. Landiolol, an ultrashort-acting beta-blocker, offers selective heart rate (HR) control in pediatric patients with tachycardia during cardiac surgery.
